name: Video Downloader
description: Probe a video page and save the rendition you pick, with the engine, queue and folder handling kept on your machine.
downloader.title: Video Downloader
downloader.subtitle: Paste a link, choose a quality, and the file lands in your download folder.
preview.ffmpegNote: This rendition arrives as separate video and audio tracks and is merged with ffmpeg.
preview.ffmpegAuto: ffmpeg is fetched automatically the first time a merge is needed.
preview.singlePart: Single file, no extra tools needed.
queue.title: Downloads
settings.directoryHint: Where finished files are moved. The path is created on demand.
settings.concurrentHint: How many links may run at the same time.
settings.multiThreadHint: Splits one file across several connections. Can help on slower links.
settings.keepPartialHint: Failed downloads leave their temporary files on disk so a retry can resume.
settings.cookieHint: Optional. Fill this when a site needs a signed-in session or only offers the better renditions to members: copy that site's Cookie value from your browser's developer tools, or paste an exported cookies.txt file.
settings.toolchainHint: Downloaded automatically the first time they are needed. Nothing to install by hand.
status.ffmpegReadyHint: Separate video and audio tracks can be merged before the file is saved.
status.ffmpegMissingHint: ffmpeg is fetched automatically the first time a rendition needs its tracks merged.
error.serviceUnavailable: The download engine did not start
error.serviceStart: The download engine did not start
error.runtimeMissing: This version's engine bundle ({{asset}}, {{version}}) is not published, so it cannot be installed. Update the plugin to a newer version.
error.runtimeDownload: Could not download the engine bundle ({{asset}}): HTTP {{status}}.
error.runtimeChecksum: The engine bundle ({{asset}}) did not match its checksum, so it was not installed.
error.runtimeInstall: The engine bundle was downloaded but could not be installed.
error.noMedia: No downloadable media was found on that page.
error.ffmpegRequired: This rendition needs ffmpeg to merge audio and video
error.enginePreparing: The download engine is still being set up in the background. Try again in a moment.
error.enginePrepareFailed: Could not download the download engine
error.ffmpegPreparing: This quality needs ffmpeg to merge the tracks, and it is being set up now. Download again in a moment.
empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.hint: Paste a video link above to see its formats and download it.
error.networkBlocked: Could not reach that site. Check your network or proxy, then try again.
error.networkTimeout: Connecting to that site timed out. Check your network or proxy, then try again.
error.authRequired: That site needs a real browser session. Add the site cookie in settings and try again.
error.siteBlocked: The site refused the request (anti-bot check). Retrying later may help, but this page cannot be fetched today.
error.noLink: That text does not contain a link. Paste a video link or a share message.
error.siteUnsupported: That link is not supported yet. Make sure it points at a video page.
